data.name: Rajesh
data.gender_notes: Rajesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rajesh is a name of Sanskrit origin meaning 'ruler', 'king', or 'lord'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rajas', which translates to 'passion, desire, or color'. The name Rajesh signifies one who is in control of their emotions and desires, and is a fitting name for a strong and powerful individual. The name Rajesh carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Rajesh usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Rajesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajesh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
